source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 · lesson 28. Exercises reused from the lesson; du'aas flagged for review.
topic: After salah on time, the next-best deed

learn.en: After obeying Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, we must obey our parents: polite, helpful, and quick when they ask.
learn.title: Obey and help

learn.en: A man asked the Prophet ﷺ: which deed does Allah love most? He said: prayer on time. The next? Kindness to parents.
learn.title: The next-best deed

learn.en: If you are kind to your parents, they will love you — and when they are happy with you, Allah is happy with you too.
learn.title: Their happiness matters

learn.en: “And your Lord has decreed that you worship none but Him, and that you be good to your parents.” (Qur'an 17:23)
learn.title: From the Qur'an

quiz.en: Which deed did the Prophet ﷺ say Allah loves most?
Your father says: homework before playing. What do you do?
True or false? When our parents are happy with us, Allah is happy with us too.

think.q: What is one small thing you can do today to make your parents happy?
think.a: Help without being asked — set the table, tidy up, or give a hug!

parents.summary: Kindness to parents (birr al-wālidayn): obey, help and be polite; it is the best deed after salah on time.
parents.tip: Notice and praise every kind thing he does for you this week.
